defect: DisassemblyFunction::getLineNum with findStart only matches an address within 4 bytes of a line start, so an address inside a two-opcode macro line (li or lui+load/store, 8 bytes) falls through and returns line 0, which breaks stepping.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added lineAddresses[i]+4 test with the next line's address; the file is new in this change, which itself creates the 8-byte macro lines.

defect: The new signal JUMP/CALL/RET handlers move currentList->pc without calling UpdateCycles, so cycleLastPC keeps the old pc and the next cycle count is taken across the jump (wrong, possibly huge GPU cycle totals).
reason: The fix adds UpdateCycles before each pc change in exactly the three handlers this change implemented; the ordinary JUMP/CALL/RET commands in the context already do this.

defect: CreateGraphicsPipeline now AddRefs every shader module and keeps them in shaderModules, but ~D3D11Pipeline never releases them, leaking the modules and their D3D11 shaders.
reason: The fix adds the matching Release loop in the destructor (moving the class definition so Release can be called); the unmatched AddRef is this change's.

defect: The new Jit_WeightsU16 fast paths are wrong: case 3 reads the third weight from weightoff instead of weightoff+4, and cases 1 and 2 write only 4 bytes, leaving the second weight dword uninitialised where the old loop zero-padded it.
reason: The fix corrects the offset and adds the zero stores inside exactly the switch this change added.

defect: The saturation added to Int_Vf2i compares and assigns in float, where 0x7fffffff rounds to 2^31, so positive overflow still converts out of range to 0x80000000; the fix does the cap in double.
reason: The cap lines are this change's, but positive overflow gave the same wrong 0x80000000 before the change (there was no cap at all), so the change left an existing bug unfixed rather than introducing one.

defect: The new specular term adds att*spot*lsc*msc*pow(dot(H,N),k) without checking that the dot product is positive, so light from behind gives negative or NaN specular contributions.
reason: The fix wraps exactly this added specular accumulation in a specular_factor > 0 check; the diffuse check and colour clamping it also adds concern code that was already unguarded before.

defect: KeyMappingNewKeyDialog::update overwrites last_kb_key with key_queue[0] on every frame, so it drops back to 0 as soon as no key is pressed and the dialog forgets the last pressed key.
reason: The fix makes exactly this added assignment conditional on a non-zero key; render's own last_kb_key != 0 test shows that 0 means no key.

defect: Moving the Rendering Backend submenu translation to MENU_EMULATION with the stale SUBMENU_RENDERING_BACKEND = 7 makes it overwrite Emulation menu item 7, the Enable Atrac3+ entry, with the Rendering Backend text (the submenu is item 11).
reason: The Atrac3+ mistranslation the fix names appears only with this change's MENU_EMULATION line; seeing it needs the enum outside the hunk and the menu layout in ppsspp.rc (the misplaced accelerator strings the fix also moves are older).

defect: The new AuCtx decoder decodes in place from AuBuf, so a frame cut off at the end of the buffer gives a zero-output decode (a silent gap) and is re-read by rewinding readPos, which produces non-smooth sound and incomplete frames.
reason: The fix replaces this buffering strategy (inbuff/writePos, the AuBufAvailable == 0 refill test, reporting AuBufSize as read size) that this WIP change introduced, though later commits also edited it; judging the gap needs the sceMp3 caller and FFmpeg behaviour.

defect: Moving the lock inside the bEnableSound branch also moved the 'Audio outbuffer overrun' log into the sound-disabled else branch, so it fires on every update with sound off (reading outAudioQueue without the lock) and never on a real overrun.
reason: The fix moves the log back under the room() check; the misplacement is in the lines this change rewrote.

defect: The new Vec2<float> SSE operator specialisations run 4-lane __m128 operations on a two-float vector whose upper lanes are never initialised, reading indeterminate data and making Vec2 arithmetic very slow.
reason: The fix removes exactly these added Vec2<float> specialisations because of the slowdown and keeps the Vec3/Vec4 ones; the defect is mainly performance, with the uninitialised-lane read as the undefined part.

defect: primsThisFrame_ is now incremented only when process is true, so with a restricted prim range the counter stops at the first skipped prim, every later prim is skipped as well, and prim counting breaks.
reason: The fix moves the increment back before the range test (compensating on the skip-once path); the conditional increment is this change's.

defect: The new secondary-texture descriptor write reuses the same VkDescriptorImageInfo tex as the main texture, so both writes point to the secondary view and sampler and the shader-blend texture overwrites the normal texture binding.
reason: The fix splits tex into tex[2]; the shared struct is in the block this change added.

defect: The fog bit is put at bit 9 of the fragment shader ID, overlapping the 3-bit alpha test function in bits 9-11, so shaders that differ in fog (now emitted by this change) can share an ID.
reason: The fix moves the fog bit to 12 in the line this change uncommented.

defect: The fixed-point UCVTF scale 15 was added to Jit_TcU16Prescale, which already multiplies by uvScale, instead of Jit_TcU16ToFloat, breaking prescaled U16 texture coordinates.
reason: The fix (titled 'changed the wrong function') moves the scale to Jit_TcU16ToFloat; the U8 change beside it shows which function was meant.

defect: RetroLogCallback receives the function pointer log_cb as userdata but casts it to retro_log_printf_t* and dereferences it, calling through garbage and crashing.
reason: The fix casts userdata directly to retro_log_printf_t; both the registration and the wrong cast are in this change.

defect: The grid snap subtracts (touch - current centre) % grid, so a control only moves in grid steps relative to where it already is and never aligns to an actual grid.
reason: The fix changes exactly these two added snap lines to snap against a fixed origin; the relative snapping is this change's.

defect: AchievementDisabled passes achievement->title, a std::string, to the %s of INFO_LOG's varargs, which is undefined behaviour.
reason: The fix adds .c_str() to the log line this change added; that title is a std::string is declared in the Achievement struct in the header.

defect: LoadedFont::GetFontLib now indexes fontLibList[fontLibID_] unconditionally while Close() sets fontLibID_ to (u32)-1, so __FontShutdown calling GetFontLib on a closed font reads out of bounds and crashes.
reason: The fix returns NULL for closed fonts; before the change a closed font simply had a null fontLib_ pointer.

defect: For mtvc into VFPU_CTRL_CC the new code emits MOV(gpr.R(MIPS_REG_VFPUCC), rt), passing the MIPS register number as an ARM register instead of gpr.R(rt), so the wrong host register is copied into CC.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added MOV to gpr.R(rt); the mfvc branch in the same diff does it correctly.

defect: The Skip Buffer Effects menu item now sends gpu_configChanged instead of gpu_resized, and the config-changed path no longer notifies the framebuffer manager of a render resize, so toggling it has no immediate effect.
reason: The fix changes exactly this rewritten message to gpu_renderResized; that the config-changed path lacks NotifyRenderResized is in GPUCommon.cpp.

defect: The new sceCccEncodeUTF16 encodes any u32 without rejecting code points above 0x10FFFF or in the surrogate range, and returns the advanced pointer where the real function returns nothing.
reason: The fix adds the range check (substituting the error character) and makes the function void in code this change added; the expected behaviour comes from PSP tests and the native UTF-16 encoder.

defect: getReferenceValue tests REF_INDEX_USEC twice, so the new ticks reference never returns CoreTiming::GetTicks() and falls through to -1.
reason: Copy-paste slip in lines this change added; the fix changes the second test to REF_INDEX_TICKS.

defect: The added test bc && (w & 3) != 0 || (h & 3) != 0 parses as (bc && w-test) || h-test, so the D3D11 block-size warning also fires for non-block-compressed textures whose height is not a multiple of 4.
reason: The fix adds the missing parentheses in both copies of the test this change added; the effect is a wrong warning only.

defect: The guard swaps the bounds when endAddr > startAddr, i.e. exactly when they are already ordered, so lower_bound(start) lies past upper_bound(end) and the loop and erase run over an invalid range (hang or undefined behaviour).
reason: The fix flips the comparison in the line this change added.

defect: The new WZR shortcut is also taken for loads whenever rt currently holds the immediate 0, so the loaded value goes to WZR and rt keeps the stale 0.
reason: The fix adds !load to exactly this changed condition; before, WZR was used only for $zero.

defect: The rewritten ComboKey constructor drops the toggle_(toggle) initialiser, leaving toggle_ uninitialised so combo keys toggle or not at random.
reason: The fix restores the initialiser that this change's constructor line removed.

defect: CreateCodeList now allocates enableCheat with new bool[] on every call (from CreateViews and the new call in OnBack) and never frees it, leaking the array.
reason: The fix adds delete[] enableCheat in OnBack; this change replaced the static array with the unfreed heap allocation.

defect: canDiscardVertex is set to GetBugs().Has(BROKEN_NAN_IN_CONDITIONAL) without the negation of the old code, so vertex range culling is enabled on exactly the drivers with the NaN bug.
reason: The fix adds the missing ! to the line this change wrote; the removed code shows the intended negation.

defect: The spotlight angle is computed as toLight.Normalize() * lightDir.Normalize(), but Normalize() returns the previous length, so angle is a product of lengths instead of a cosine and spotlights are wrong.
reason: The fix switches to Normalized() in this added line; that Normalize returns the length is in Math3D.h.

defect: The new IR Comp_Allegrex2 emits BSwap16 for wsbw, so word byte swaps are compiled as halfword swaps (the immediate path correctly uses swap32).
reason: Copy-paste slip in the new file; the fix changes it to BSwap32.

defect: In the new 0xD address-compare code addr2 is GetAddress(arg & 0xFFFFFFFF), keeping the 4-7 type nibble in the address, so the address is invalid and the compare never runs.
reason: The fix masks with 0x0FFFFFFF like addr1, in the code this change added.

defect: The new Int_Vsocp clamps with std::min/std::max, which turn a NaN input into 0 or 1 instead of propagating NaN as the PSP does.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added clamps with NaN-preserving nanclamp; vsocp had no interpreter implementation before, and the NaN rule needs hardware knowledge rather than code.

defect: IniFile::Load breaks out of the loop when in.eof() is set after getline, so a last line without a trailing newline is dropped and then deleted on the next save.
reason: The fix removes this eof check from the file this change added (adapted from Dolphin, but new in this repository).

defect: EmuScreen::key passes the raw key.keyCode to onVKeyDown/onVKeyUp, which switch on virtual key ids such as VIRTKEY_UNTHROTTLE, so the unthrottle virtual key never works (the old unthrottle handling was removed in the same change).
reason: The fix passes result instead in the lines this change added.

defect: __AudioDoState re-registers the host audio event with hleAudioUpdate instead of hleHostAudioUpdate, so after loading a savestate the host audio update runs the wrong callback.
reason: Copy-paste slip in the function this change added; the fix names the right callback.

defect: The decrypted EBOOT dump writes head->elf_size bytes instead of the decrypted length returned by pspDecryptPRX, so the dumped file has the wrong length.
reason: The fix passes ret instead in the call this change added; what the header size and the return value mean is defined in PrxDecrypter.

defect: The new GetVectorRegsPrefixD and ApplyPrefixD assert on JitState::PREFIX_KNOWN, a name the ARM JIT does not have (it uses ArmJitState), so debug and iOS ARM builds fail to compile.
reason: The fix renames both to ArmJitState in lines this port added; Comp_VPFX in the same diff already uses ArmJitState.

defect: KernelLoadExecParam reads the PSP struct into SceKernelLoadExecParam with host pointer fields, casts them with (u32)param.argp and stores new[] buffers back into them, which breaks on 64-bit hosts (struct layout, pointer truncation) and is rejected by clang.
reason: The fix makes the fields u32 PSP addresses and keeps the host buffers separately; the pointer casts and stores come from this change (moved inline by a later commit).

defect: The new sprintf passes controllerMaps.size() (a size_t) to a %i conversion, undefined behaviour on 64-bit hosts.
reason: The fix casts it to int in the line this change added; the rest of that fix in this file is whitespace.
